available_terms.notes: Fall/Spring/Summer/Winter | Excel Col E also notes Winter term

min_standing_note.value: Exchange students exempt from English tests if having >=1 yr full-time study at an English-medium university; UG/GR eligible per agreement.

excluded_majors.notes: Fact Sheet p.4 explicitly states School of Medicine, Nursing, and Pharmacy do not allow exchange student enrollment.

min_gpa_host.notes: Official transcript displaying at least 3.0 cumulative GPA out of 4.0.

english_course_availability.notes: US state flagship university teaching all regular programs in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Exempt if attending a university where English is the medium of instruction for >=1 year full-time (applies to AUC) or qualifying HS diploma <=2 yrs old. Otherwise: UG TOEFL iBT 68 / IELTS 6.0 / PTE 47 / Duolingo 95 / C1-C2 169; GR iBT 79 / IELTS 6.5 / PTE 53 / Duolingo 105 / C1-C2 176; Law School TOEFL iBT 100.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall Semester: Classes Aug 17 - Dec 12, 2026 (Fall Break Oct 8-9, 2026); arrive >=1 week prior for orientation (Fact Sheet p.2).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring Semester: Classes Jan 18 - May 15, 2027 (Spring Break Mar 14-21, 2027); arrive >=1 week prior (Fact Sheet p.2).

tuition_model.notes: Fact Sheet p.6 states: 'exchange students are not required to pay UNM tuition' (non-tuition mandatory/course fees still apply).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly UG living budget from UNM 2026-27 academic-year Cost of Attendance divided by 10 months (2 semesters x 5 mo): Housing & Food $10,648-$12,471 + Books $1,869 + Transportation $2,498 + Misc/Personal $2,800 = $17,815-$19,638/AY ($8,907.50-$9,819/sem -> $1,781.50-$1,963.80/mo). Visa financial proof minimum is $7,500/sem ($15,000/AY) per Fact Sheet p.3.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly USD range 1,782-1,964 (midpoint 1,873.0)/month. No FX conversion (1 USD = 1.0 USD; 5-month equivalent = 5 * 1,873.0 USD = 9,365.00 USD), calculated 2026-11-15.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Per semester: Visa Processing & Admin Fee $275, Mandatory IT Fee $50, Department/Upper-Division Course Fees $25-$400 per class, plus mandatory UNM-negotiated International Student Health Insurance (non-US citizens; emergency coverage only) and US Gov SEVIS fee.

housing_availability.notes: Exchange students arrange their own housing using UNM resources: on-campus housing (http://housing.unm.edu/), off-campus portal (https://och.unm.edu/), and ISSS Albuquerque housing guide.

housing_notes.value: On-campus housing and off-campus listings provided on Fact Sheet p.6 (Housing & Food AY 2026-27 estimate $10,648-$12,471 on unm.edu COA).

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No UNM incoming exchange grant verified.

citizenship_restrictions.value: US citizens cannot purchase UNM International Student Health Insurance (contact exchange@unm.edu).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Visa requires liquid financial proof (<6 months old; no loans/credit cards/investments): $7,500 (1 semester), $15,000 (Academic Year Aug-May), $17,500 (Calendar Year Jan-Dec), or $4,375 (Summer), plus US SEVIS fee.

english_course_list_url.notes: All courses in https://registrar.unm.edu/UNM%20Catalog/index.html are taught in English; no separate English-only URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester credits (3 cr = 3 contact hrs/wk over 16 weeks). Immigration minimum: 12 credits UG, 9 credits GR per semester.

course_restrictions_note.value: School of Medicine, Nursing, and Pharmacy are completely closed to exchange students; restrictions apply to Law, Nutrition, and Architecture courses (contact exchange@unm.edu).

value: Official transcript (>=3.0 GPA, certified English translation)
English proficiency proof (unless >=1 yr English-medium study exemption)

academic_style.value: 16-week semester US state research university (A-F grading rubric; transcripts issued 45-60 days post-term, $10 extra copies).

city_tier.notes: Located in Albuquerque, New Mexico; city population figure not verified inside Fact Sheet.

campus_type.notes: Main campus in Albuquerque, NM; campus_type label not explicitly classified in Fact Sheet.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated on unm.edu or Fact Sheet (US English-speaking campus).

international_support_services.value: Global Education Office / ISSS advising, check-in & orientation (>=1 wk prior), housing portals, and negotiated international student medical coverage.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Semester: Partner Nomination Mar 15, Student Application Mar 31. Spring Semester: Partner Nomination Sep 15, Student Application Sep 30 (nomination links emailed Feb/Aug).
